visualCharacteristics.purpose: Article or press release body beside a narrow sidebar with contact cards and downloads
visualCharacteristics.layout: Main text column 8 of 12 beside a 4-column sidebar from 960px; stacked on smaller screens
notable: Sidebar picture + name + phone / e-mail becomes a raised contact card
File links become bordered download boxes with a meta line
Tables in the body scroll sideways
light / light-2 sit on a tinted band

contentPattern.structure: One row, two cells: main body (headings, text, lists, tables, images) and sidebar (contact card picture + text + links, download links with file meta, further-information text); the sidebar cell may be a fragment link

usage: Use for the body of articles and press releases that carry a contact and downloads sidebar.
reuseGuidance: Fits long text beside short supporting material; use columns for equal columns and text-media for text beside a single image.
